# Woven over-under -- PLA, nozzle 205C, bed 60C, M221 S100

**Not yet print-tested.** Generated by `ideas_test.mjs woven`; no library function exists for this texture.

Warp = lines along X, weft = lines along Y, bead 0.5 x 0.2, F900. Layer 1: full warp lines; weft lines broken 0.6mm either side of every warp line. Layers 2 and 3 (Z 0.4, 0.6): at each crossing, a 2.4mm bump on whichever thread is 'over' -- on the warp it sits on the warp; on the weft it bridges the break and crosses on top of the warp. The 'under' thread stays broken, so it reads as passing beneath. A real under-pass is not printable (the nozzle can't fit under a strand), so this is a relief imitation.

Calibration line: `freeformSolid` x=120-180, y=60, printed first. Part fan on (`M106 S255`) after it, off at the end. Textures occupy x 19-85, y 24-84. `verifyLayout` (3mm min gap): ok=true, 0 warnings.

| id | position (x0, y0) | parameters | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| W1 | 19.0, 24.0 | 24x24mm, 6 x 6 lines | plain weave, 4mm grid |
| W2 | 59.0, 24.0 | 24x24mm, 8 x 8 lines | plain weave, 3mm grid |
| W3 | 19.0, 58.0 | 24x24mm, 8 x 8 lines | 2/2 twill, 3mm grid -- diagonal ribs |
| W4 | 59.0, 58.0 | 24x24mm, 6 x 6 lines | CONTROL: plain crosshatch, no over/under |

**What to look for**: Does W1/W2 read as fabric under the finger compared with W4? Does the twill (W3) give a diagonal grain? Did the weft bridges over the breaks hold or sag into gaps?

Totals: 4532 G-code lines, 551 retractions, 85.6 mm commanded filament.
